questions.prompt: The walk back reaches the amount to keep at message 5, a tool result. Message 4 is its tool call. Where does the cut go?
options: Before message 5, because the total was reached there
Before message 4, so the call stays with its result
After message 5, so both are shortened
At message 0, so everything is shortened
questions.explanation: A cut before message 5 would leave the call in the shortened range and its result in the kept part. The rule moves the cut back to before message 4.

questions.prompt: Why does the range start at position 1 when position 0 is the system prompt?
options: The system prompt is always shorter than 1 token
Position 0 is never priced by the meter
The system prompt stays outside the shortened range
Providers reject requests that start with a user message
questions.explanation: The rule skips a system prompt at position 0, so the instructions stay word for word at the start of the request.

questions.prompt: With a window of 10,000 tokens and a reply reserve of 1,000, how much recent history does the rule keep at least?
questions.explanation: The amount to keep is 16% of the window after the reply reserve: (10,000 - 1,000) x 0.16 = 1,440. The trace kept 1,600 because the cut moved back.
